positive.prompt: Use $zero-trust-delivery. Use the zero-trust delivery workflow to implement and verify this repository change.

Use $implementation-strategy. Create a bounded implementation strategy for this validated contract; do not edit code.

Use $independent-review. Independently review this exact SHA and return only evidence-backed findings.
Use $finding-verification-repair. Falsify these review findings and repair only confirmed defects within the cycle budget.
Use $release-readiness. Assess merge and release readiness from these exact evidence records without deploying.
Use $delivery-retrospective. Run a delivery retrospective from evidence and token metrics and propose one experiment.
Use $autonomous-continuity. Resume the durable scheduler, recover expired leases, and continue all runnable tasks without converting blockers into success.

Use $recovery-and-takeover. Apply the bounded recovery ladder after repeated worker failure and require fresh closure review after takeover.
Use $multi-model-mesh. Benchmark qualified providers, build a bounded parallel DAG, isolate writers, and run the evidence-gated multi-model mesh.
